status: DRAFT: priors, weights and loss fractions are hand-set approximations of published extension guidance, not transcribed tables. Pending agronomy review by Caleb. Citations name the publication family to verify. Naming rules, stage windows and caps follow docs/research/grounding.md; every number flagged [design] there is a design value to calibrate.

sources.isu_hail: Iowa State Univ. Extension, corn and soybean hail damage guides (yield loss by stage and defoliation)
sources.purdue_water: Purdue Univ. Extension (R.L. Nielsen), corn water stress around silking and grain fill
sources.unl_irrig: Univ. of Nebraska-Lincoln Extension, center pivot irrigation scheduling and failure effects
sources.umn_n: Univ. of Minnesota / Iowa State Extension, corn nitrogen deficiency symptoms and loss
sources.cropprotection: Crop Protection Network (corn, soybean disease guides: tar spot, gray leaf spot, SDS)
sources.ipmpipe: Corn ipmPIPE / EDDMapS county disease reports
sources.ksu_drift: K-State / Univ. of Missouri Extension, herbicide drift symptoms and soybean/corn injury
sources.isu_stand: Iowa State Univ. Extension, corn and soybean planter skips, stand and yield
sources.isu_flood: Iowa State / Purdue Extension, flooding and ponding effects on corn and soybean
sources.fema_nfhl: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer, Special Flood Hazard Area zones (draft weight, pending agronomy review)
sources.usgs_nhd_usfws_nwi: USGS National Hydrography Dataset streams and USFWS National Wetlands Inventory (draft weight, pending agronomy review)
sources.nrcs_soil: USDA NRCS Soil Data Access / Web Soil Survey (sandy texture, available water capacity)
sources.noaa_mrms: NOAA MRMS MESH radar hail estimate; SPC storm reports
sources.rma: USDA RMA Loss Adjustment Standards Handbook / Crop Insurance Handbook
sources.nass: USDA NASS Crop Production and Quick Stats (state yield trend)
sources.analyzer: FieldWatch analyzer pattern features (docs/data-pipelines.md M3); weight set by hand
sources.farmer: Farmer's own report (farmer_reply); weight set by hand
sources.photo: Photo diagnosis by the imagery specialist; weight set by hand
sources.unl_si: Univ. of Nebraska-Lincoln (Holland and Schepers 2010) sufficiency index for in-season corn nitrogen; Iowa State in-season N guidance (grounding memo section 3.2; thresholds are design values)

stage_groups.early: planting to V5 (soy: VE to V3)
stage_groups.vegetative: V6 to pre-tassel (soy: V4 to before R1)
stage_groups.grain_fill: R3 to R5 (soy: R3 to R5)

pivot_failure.label: Pivot not watering
pivot_failure.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate (no sourced replacement in the grounding memo). Stage bonuses removed: the stage window below is now a hard gate (memo 5.3).
pivot_failure.scout_for: the last tower, nozzles and sprinkler package: is the span stopped, leaking or plugged?

ring_pattern_strong.reason: A ring or arc at one radius matches a clogged or dead span (last-span path).
ring_pattern_strong.how: Problem area ring score at or above 0.6 (analyzer pattern feature).

ring_pattern_weak.reason: A faint ring is weak support for a span problem.
ring_pattern_weak.how: Problem area ring score from 0.3 up to 0.6.

wedge_pattern_strong.reason: A sector stress shape fits a stuck or leaking span or end-gun issue.
wedge_pattern_strong.how: Problem area wedge score at or above 0.6.

edge_pattern_strong.reason: Edge-band stress can be a pivot corner or end-of-run shortfall.
edge_pattern_strong.how: Problem area edge-band score at or above 0.6.

farmer_reports_pivot_down.reason: The farmer says the pivot was down or erroring.
farmer_reports_pivot_down.how: Farmer input: pivot reported down (fixed field).

farmer_reports_pivot_ok.reason: The farmer says the pivot ran normally and on schedule.
farmer_reports_pivot_ok.how: Farmer input: pivot reported running normally (fixed field).

rain_deficit_30d.reason: A dry month raises reliance on the pivot, so a failure shows up sooner.
rain_deficit_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: below 0.6.

rain_normal_30d.reason: Normal rain masks a short pivot outage.
rain_normal_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: from 0.7 to 1.3.

stress_uniform_field.reason: Whole-field uniform stress points away from a localized irrigation fault. (Direction corrected from the old code, which counted it as support.)
stress_uniform_field.how: Problem area covers 70% or more of the field acres.

hail.label: Hail damage
hail.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate. Stage bonuses removed: the stage window is now a hard gate.
hail.scout_for: shredded or torn leaves, bruised stalks and broken stems 7 to 10 days after the storm

hail_mesh_large.reason: Radar hail estimate at or above 25 mm over the field.
hail_mesh_large.how: Hail report max size at or above 25 mm over the field, or an open hail watch that says so.

hail_mesh_moderate.reason: Radar hail estimate of 12-25 mm over part of the field.
hail_mesh_moderate.how: Hail report max size from 12 to 25 mm, or an open hail watch with no size given.

no_hail_mesh.reason: Radar shows no hail over the field in the window.
no_hail_mesh.how: Hail was checked: max size 0 and no open hail watch.

hail_ground_report_near.reason: A storm report of hail within about 10 km.
hail_ground_report_near.how: At least one ground report within 10 km in the hail report.

hail_swath_overlap_high.reason: The stressed area lines up with the hail swath.
hail_swath_overlap_high.how: Problem area overlap with the hail swath at or above 0.5.

hail_swath_no_overlap.reason: The stressed area is outside the hail swath.
hail_swath_no_overlap.how: Problem area overlap with the hail swath below 0.1.

photo_leaf_shredding.reason: Photo shows torn, shredded leaves and bruised stalks.
photo_leaf_shredding.how: Photo input: leaf shredding seen (fixed field).

sudden_drop_after_storm.reason: NDVI dropped sharply right after a storm date.
sudden_drop_after_storm.how: Median crop-health change since the last clear pass of -0.10 or worse AND the hail peak date falls between the two passes.

drought.label: Dry weather stress
drought.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate. Stage bonuses removed: the stage window is now a hard gate.
drought.scout_for: leaf rolling that starts in the morning, dry topsoil and stress on ridges and sandy knolls

rain_deficit_30d.reason: Rain over 30 days well below normal.
rain_deficit_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: below 0.6.

rain_normal_30d.reason: Rain over 30 days near or above normal.
rain_normal_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: from 0.7 to 1.3.

drought_monitor_d1_plus.reason: County is D1 or worse on the Drought Monitor.
drought_monitor_d1_plus.how: Drought Monitor category D1, D2, D3 or D4 for the county.

drought_monitor_none.how: Drought Monitor category none for the county.

heat_days_over_35c.reason: Several days above 35 C add water demand.
heat_days_over_35c.how: Three or more days above 35 C (95 F) in the 30-day weather summary.

stress_uniform_field.reason: Broad field-wide stress fits weather rather than a local fault.
stress_uniform_field.how: Problem area covers 70% or more of the field acres.

pattern_localized.reason: Stress in a sharp local shape is less typical of drought alone.
pattern_localized.how: Problem area has a ring, wedge, edge or stripe score at or above 0.6.

ponding.label: Standing water / waterlogging
ponding.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate. Stage bonus removed: the stage window (emergence to R2, memo 3.4) is now a hard gate.
ponding.scout_for: standing water, yellowed or drowned plants and soil crusting in the low ground

lowspot_overlap_high.reason: The stressed area sits in the terrain low spots.
lowspot_overlap_high.how: Problem area overlap with the low-spot mask at or above 0.5.

lowspot_overlap_none.reason: The stressed area is not in low spots.
lowspot_overlap_none.how: Problem area overlap with the low-spot mask below 0.15.

heavy_rain_7d.reason: Heavy rain in the last week (about 50 mm or more).
heavy_rain_7d.how: 50 mm or more of rain in the last 7 days of the weather summary (or one day of 50 mm in a tool summary).

rain_excess_30d.reason: Rain over 30 days well above normal.
rain_excess_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: 1.5 or more.

soil_poorly_drained.reason: Soil map units are poorly or somewhat poorly drained.
soil_poorly_drained.how: Soil map units labelled poorly drained cover half the field or more.

soil_well_drained.reason: Soil map units are well drained.
soil_well_drained.how: Soil map units labelled well drained cover half the field or more.

photo_standing_water.reason: Photo shows standing water or yellowed drowned plants.
photo_standing_water.how: Photo input: standing water or drowned plants seen (fixed field).

floodplain_overlap_high.reason: Much of the stressed field lies in a mapped FEMA flood zone.
floodplain_overlap_high.how: FEMA flood-zone share of the field at 50% or more.

stream_or_wetland_adjacent.reason: A mapped stream or wetland borders the field.
stream_or_wetland_adjacent.how: Stream within 100 m of the field, or any mapped wetland share.

outside_floodplain.reason: The field is outside mapped flood zones.
outside_floodplain.how: FEMA flood-zone share is 0 and flood zones were returned.

nitrogen.label: Nitrogen shortage
nitrogen.prior_reason: Prior kept at 0.12. The corn (+0.5) and stage (+0.3 vegetative, +0.3 flowering, -1.0 early) bonuses are removed: the memo found no source for them and they alone lifted nitrogen to 'likely' on weather (memo 5.2). Soybeans stay at -2.5 (memo 3.2).

tier_cap.why: Founder decision: satellite alone only supports 'possible nitrogen variation, please confirm'; 'likely' needs the farmer's own report (N short or application records).

nitrogen.scout_for: V-shaped yellowing from the leaf tip on the lower leaves (nitrogen) versus yellow striping on the new leaves (sulfur); ask what nitrogen rate and date were applied

rain_excess_30d.reason: Wet spells leach or denitrify nitrogen.
rain_excess_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: 1.5 or more. Regional context only, never enough alone.

corn_after_corn.reason: Corn after corn needs more nitrogen and gets no rotation credit.
corn_after_corn.how: Last year's crop in the crop history is corn and this year's crop is corn.

prior_crop_soybeans.reason: Soybean rotation credit lowers nitrogen need. (Direction corrected: it makes a nitrogen shortage less likely, not more.)
prior_crop_soybeans.how: Last year's crop in the crop history is soybeans.

n_red_edge_si_low.reason: The stressed area's red-edge reading is under 90% of the field's best tenth, in the V6-V12 window.
n_red_edge_si_low.how: Red-edge index of the problem area divided by the field's top-10% (P90) red-edge value is below 0.90, corn V6-V12 only. Needs the problem area's red-edge value; not evaluable without it.

n_red_edge_si_borderline.reason: The stressed area's red-edge reading is 90-95% of the field's best tenth, in the V6-V12 window.
n_red_edge_si_borderline.how: Same sufficiency index from 0.90 up to 0.95.

photo_v_shaped_firing.reason: Photo shows V-shaped yellowing from leaf tip on lower leaves.
photo_v_shaped_firing.how: Photo input: V-shaped firing seen (fixed field).

farmer_reports_n_short.reason: The farmer applied less nitrogen than planned.
farmer_reports_n_short.how: Farmer input: nitrogen reported short, or application records below plan (fixed field).

farmer_reports_n_full.reason: The farmer applied the full nitrogen rate on time.
farmer_reports_n_full.how: Farmer input: full nitrogen rate reported (fixed field).

sandy_soil_overlap_high.reason: Sandy zones lose nitrogen to leaching.
sandy_soil_overlap_high.how: Problem area overlap with sandy soil zones at or above 0.5.

herbicide_drift.label: Herbicide drift
herbicide_drift.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate. Stage bonuses removed. Never named from imagery alone (memo 3.8): see tier_cap.

tier_cap.why: Memo 3.8: satellite imagery shows an edge gradient, never drift. Naming needs a neighbor-spray report or a photo of cupped or strapped leaves.

herbicide_drift.scout_for: cupped, strapped or crinkled new leaves, worst along the edge nearest a neighbor's sprayed field; ask who sprayed and when

edge_pattern_strong.reason: Injury concentrated on one field edge fits drift from a neighbor.
edge_pattern_strong.how: Problem area edge-band score at or above 0.6.

edge_pattern_none.reason: No edge concentration is less typical of drift.

photo_leaf_cupping.reason: Photo shows cupped, strapped or crinkled new leaves.
photo_leaf_cupping.how: Photo input: leaf cupping seen (fixed field).

wind_during_spray_window.reason: Breezy spray-season days with a neighbor application.
wind_during_spray_window.how: Two or more days with wind of 24 km/h (15 mph) or more in the weather summary.

farmer_reports_neighbor_spray.reason: The farmer knows a neighbor sprayed nearby.
farmer_reports_neighbor_spray.how: Farmer input: neighbor spray reported (fixed field).

planter_skip.label: Planter or equipment skips
planter_skip.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate. The stage bonuses (+1.0 early ... -2.0 maturity) are removed: the V2-V10 (soybean VE-V5) window is now a hard gate (memo 3.7).
planter_skip.scout_for: missing plants or uneven emergence along the straight bands; measure the band width against the planter or sprayer

stripe_pattern_strong.reason: Straight parallel bands match planter row units or sprayer passes.
stripe_pattern_strong.how: Problem area stripe score at or above 0.6.

stripe_pattern_none.reason: No stripe geometry in the stressed area.

stripe_width_matches_implement.reason: Band spacing matches the planter or sprayer width.
stripe_width_matches_implement.how: Needs the stripe width and implement width; not evaluable until those inputs exist.

photo_gaps_in_row.reason: Photo shows missing plants or doubles along the row.
photo_gaps_in_row.how: Photo input: gaps in the row seen (fixed field).

farmer_reports_planter_issue.reason: The farmer remembers a planter or sprayer problem.
farmer_reports_planter_issue.how: Farmer input: planter or sprayer problem reported (fixed field).

disease_pest.label: Disease or insects
disease_pest.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate. Stage bonuses removed. Never named without a photo (memo 3.9): the required evidence is a photo finding.
disease_pest.scout_for: lesions on the leaves (tar spot, gray leaf spot, sudden death syndrome) and insects or chewing damage; check the county disease reports

disease_confirmed_county.reason: Tar spot, gray leaf spot, SDS or similar confirmed in the county this season.
disease_confirmed_county.how: Any county disease report with status confirmed this year.

disease_history_county.reason: The county has a history of the disease in past seasons.
disease_history_county.how: Any county disease report with status history.

no_disease_reports_county.reason: No confirmed disease reports in the county this season.
no_disease_reports_county.how: County reports were checked and none is confirmed this year.

humid_wet_weather_30d.reason: Warm, humid and wet weather favors foliar disease.
humid_wet_weather_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days of 1.3 or more AND average daily high between 20 and 32 C.

dry_weather_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: below 0.6.

patchy_irregular_pattern.reason: Irregular patches fit disease or insect spread.
patchy_irregular_pattern.how: Problem area has no ring, wedge, edge or stripe score at 0.3 or more, and low-spot and sandy overlap are both under 0.5.

photo_tar_spot_lesions.reason: Photo shows raised black tar-spot stromata.
photo_tar_spot_lesions.how: Photo input: tar spot seen (fixed field).

photo_gray_leaf_spot_lesions.reason: Photo shows rectangular gray lesions between veins.
photo_gray_leaf_spot_lesions.how: Photo input: gray leaf spot seen (fixed field).

photo_sds_symptoms.reason: Photo shows interveinal scorch and root or stem symptoms (soybean SDS).
photo_sds_symptoms.how: Photo input: SDS symptoms seen (fixed field).

photo_insect_feeding.reason: Photo shows insects or chewing damage.
photo_insect_feeding.how: Photo input: insects or feeding damage seen (fixed field).

photo_no_lesions.reason: Photo shows clean leaves without lesions or insects.

sandy_soil_water_stress.label: Sandy soil running short of water
sandy_soil_water_stress.prior_reason: Prior kept at the hand-set base rate. Stage bonuses removed: the stage window is now a hard gate.
sandy_soil_water_stress.scout_for: dry, loose sandy soil and stress on the sandy knolls and ridge tops

sandy_soil_overlap_high.reason: The stressed area sits on sandy, low-water-holding soil.
sandy_soil_overlap_high.how: Problem area overlap with sandy soil zones at or above 0.5.

soil_not_sandy.reason: Soil is uniform loam or silt loam, not sand.
soil_not_sandy.how: Problem area overlap with sandy soil zones below 0.15.

pattern_follows_soil_zones.how: Problem area overlap with sandy soil zones at or above 0.7 (no other soil-zone map yet).

soil_low_awc.reason: Available water capacity is low in the top 100 cm.
soil_low_awc.how: Area-weighted available water capacity of the soil map units under 12 cm in the top 100 cm.

rain_deficit_30d.reason: A dry month hits sandy soil first.
rain_deficit_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: below 0.6.

rain_normal_30d.reason: Normal rain keeps sandy soil from stressing.
rain_normal_30d.how: 30-day rain total from the weather summary divided by the normal for the same 30 days: from 0.7 to 1.3.

unknown.label: Something else / not yet clear
unknown.prior_reason: Not a competing hypothesis any more (memo 3.10, 5.1): 'cause not determined' is the outcome when no condition passes the naming rule. The entry stays so the condition id exists.
